mapper.sql: a.id, a.patient_id, p.patient_no, p.name AS patient_name, p.phone AS patient_phone, p.risk_level, a.user_id, a.doctor_id, d.real_name AS doctor_name, d.title AS doctor_title, d.hospital AS doctor_hospital, d.department AS doctor_department, a.apply_type, a.status, a.apply_reason, a.reject_reason, a.handle_by, h.real_name AS handle_name, a.handle_time, a.create_time
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM patient_doctor_apply a INNER JOIN patient p ON p.id = a.patient_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user d ON d.id = a.doctor_id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user h ON h.id = a.handle_by AND h.deleted = 0 WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.id = #{id}
